chapterIds.title: 一颗分子往回走，整滴墨水却散开
chapterIds.titleEn: One doubles back; the drop spreads
chapterIds.caption: 无规则运动，形成有方向的净扩散。

chapterIds.title: 水位停了，水分子没有停
chapterIds.titleEn: The level stops; molecules do not
chapterIds.caption: 混合降低水势，压力抬高水势，净流量由两侧之差决定。
chapterIds.captionEn: Mixing lowers water potential; pressure raises it. Their difference drives net flow.

chapterIds.title: 盐没有抽走整个细胞
chapterIds.titleEn: Salt does not remove the whole cell
chapterIds.caption: 失水使细胞变小，也使胞内溶质更浓。
chapterIds.captionEn: Water loss shrinks the cell and concentrates its contents.

chapterIds.title: 把失水推理带进植物细胞
chapterIds.titleEn: Bring the argument into a plant cell
chapterIds.caption: 液泡和原生质体缩小，细胞壁留在外面。
chapterIds.captionEn: The vacuole and protoplast shrink inside the wall.

chapterIds.title: 复原之后，为什么不继续胀大
chapterIds.titleEn: Why recovery does not mean endless swelling
chapterIds.caption: 靠近细胞壁后，膨压抵消进一步吸水。
chapterIds.captionEn: Wall contact builds turgor that opposes further uptake.

chapterIds.title: 水通道，改变快慢而不是方向
chapterIds.titleEn: Channels change speed, not the driving direction
chapterIds.caption: 水通道加快被动过水，反转梯度也加快失水。
chapterIds.captionEn: Channels speed passive flow, including water loss after reversal.

chapterIds.title: 蛋白质，不等于主动运输
chapterIds.titleEn: A protein does not make transport active
chapterIds.caption: 两条被动路径都消耗浓度差，平衡后仍能交换。
chapterIds.captionEn: Both passive routes reduce a gradient; exchange persists.

chapterIds.title: 用供能对照检验逆势运输
chapterIds.titleEn: Test uphill transport with an energy control
chapterIds.caption: 相同起点，供能的泵才能继续逆势积累。
chapterIds.captionEn: From the same start, only the energized pump accumulates uphill.

limits: Random trajectories illustrate unbiased thermal motion; the relative-unit water-potential model supplies the net-flow calculation. No claim of a full microscopic simulation of osmosis.
Opposing arrows are a phenomenological gross-flow decomposition, not measured molecular counts.
The plant membrane detail summarizes protoplast permeability without resolving plasma membrane and tonoplast separately.
The active pump omits voltage and leakage and does not imply every active process directly uses ATP.
The aquaporin reversed-bath shot is explicitly a teaching prediction, separate from the original functional-expression experiment.
The 1950 history is attributed to the textbook; 1988 isolation and 1992 functional evidence are separately sourced.
